column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=It is a Hispanic country, you can see a point of land jutting out.
#Text=There is the sea, the ocean all around.
#Text=There is an airport, areas of swamp land.
#Text=There are major roads, probably highways, and there are woods.
